_comment: Where installed clients fetch published data from: the repo, its `data` branch (CLAUDE.md, 'Files clients fetch at runtime'), the hosts that serve it in the order they are tried — every jsDelivr-style host (<host>/gh/<repo>@<branch>/<path>) first, then the raw-style ones (<host>/<repo>/<branch>/<path>), GitHub's own origin last — and the schedule's paths on that branch. Compiled into the desktop app (apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/github_mirror.rs, which explains the choice of hosts) and read by CI through ./schedule.ts. Build time only: a host table fetched at runtime would need a host from the table to reach it. Each release keeps the values it was built with, so a path or name here that a release has read can't be renamed.
